'''''Peerless''''' was an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] which served under [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Pellaeon]] during the [[Battle of Borosk (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Battle of Borosk]]. During the battle, ''Peerless'' provided escort to the [[Defiant (Imperial-class)|''Defiant'']], as that ship was equipped with a [[gravitic amplitude modulator]] to jam the communications of a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[yammosk]]. Following the Yuuzhan Vong withdrawal from Borosk, ''Peerless'' was among the Star Destroyers ordered deployed to assist in the [[Battle of Yaga Minor (Yuuzhan Vong War)|defense]] of [[Yaga Minor/Legends|Yaga Minor]].
